code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, neutropenia, elevated CRP and ferritin, increased INR, and mild hypoglycemia. These findings suggest significant inflammation, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation, with risk for coagulopathy. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., severe infection, sepsis, or respiratory failure) are recommended.
